points.point: Is it allowed for the same Instagram to be connected in two Blotato accounts (agency and client)
Will one connection invalidate the other account's token

verdict.reason: No candidate sentence states whether the same Instagram account can be connected in two separate Blotato accounts or whether connecting it in one affects the other's token; the agency and client-link entries only cover connecting clients under one login or with separate shared-email accounts, and the Instagram session entry covers an unrelated confirmation error.
